//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> GUI Followers -> Config

Enable GUI Followers.//: Whether GUI Followers is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

showFollowerList.//: If disabled, the follower list is not shown at all.

followerListHeaderFormat.//: The header text above the follower list.

showFollowerHealth.//: If enabled, shows the follower's health in the GUI list.

followerHealthFormat.//: The format of the health string in the GUI. <health> will be replaced by the percentage of total health.

showFollowerDistance.//: If enabled, shows the follower's distance in blocks to the player in the GUI list.

followerDistanceFormat.//: The format of the distance string in the GUI. <distance> will be replaced by distance in blocks.

distanceToCheckForFollowersAround.//: The distance in blocks around the player where the mod checks for tamed, non-sitting followers to add to the list. A value of -1 disables this feature. min: -1, max: 300

timeBetweenChecksInSeconds.//: The time in seconds in between checking for tamed, non-sitting followers around the player. min: 0, max: 3,600

entityTypesToIgnore.//: A comma-separated list of entity ids that are never shown in the follower list. Use '<modid>:*' to ignore every entity of a mod. By default contains the workers from the Villager Workers mod, which always follow.

followerListPosition.//: Where the follower list is shown at the top of the screen. options: Left, Center, Right

followerListHeightOffset.//: The vertical offset (y coord) for the follower list. This determines how far down the list should be on the screen. Can be changed to prevent GUIs from overlapping. min: 0, max: 3,000

followerListWidthOffset.//: The horizontal offset (x coord) for the follower list. A positive value moves the list to the right, a negative value to the left. min: -3,000, max: 3,000

followerListTextScale.//: The size of the follower list text. 1.0 is the normal size. min: 0.5, max: 3

drawTextShadow.//: If the text displayed should have a shadow drawn below it.

colourFollowerByHealth.//: If enabled, a follower's line changes colour based on its health, using followerHealthColours.

followerHealthColours.//: A list of <health percentage>:<R>,<G>,<B> entries separated by a semicolon, with RGB values from 0 to 255. A follower at or below that health percentage is shown in that colour. Used when colourFollowerByHealth is enabled.

RGB.//: The colour of the follower list text, as red, green and blue values from 0 to 255.
